create_variation_broadcaster: create a VariationBroadcaster wrapping a Variation object to share values across multiple callers

evaluate_broadcasted_value: evaluate a broadcasted proxy to retrieve the cached variation value for the current round

refactor_broadcasted_value_proxy: refactor the _BroadcastedValueProxy class to customize how broadcasted variation values are retrieved
